purpose: Candidate upstreams discovered during source research. Presence here does not authorize collection or imply evidentiary equivalence.
activation_rule: Promote into config/source_registry.json only after endpoint, terms/license, cadence, parser, provenance and evidence-role review.

candidates.name: POLECAT / PLOVER Event Data
candidates.preferred_use: historical validation, anomaly comparison and secondary event context
candidates.must_not_do: Do not treat machine-coded events as independently verified human-gold evidence.

candidates.name: SIPRI Databases
candidates.preferred_use: arms transfers, military expenditure, embargo and peace-operation context
candidates.must_not_do: Do not use structural SIPRI series as real-time conflict-event confirmation.

candidates.name: Airwars
candidates.preferred_use: cross-checking strike and civilian-harm claims with preserved source methodology
candidates.must_not_do: Do not collapse Airwars assessments into confirmed attribution without claim-level provenance and methodology labels.

candidates.name: International Crisis Group CrisisWatch
candidates.preferred_use: monthly escalation/de-escalation context and hypothesis generation
candidates.must_not_do: Do not use analytical prose as sensor observation or automatic event verification.

candidates.name: Correlates of War Militarized Interstate Disputes
candidates.preferred_use: long-run interstate-dispute base rates and validation baselines
candidates.must_not_do: Do not represent historical MID records as current operational reporting.

candidates.name: OONI Measurements
candidates.preferred_use: corroborate censorship, blocking and connectivity-interference hypotheses alongside IODA and RIPEstat
candidates.must_not_do: Do not equate an anomalous OONI measurement with deliberate state attribution without independent evidence and methodology-aware interpretation.

candidates.name: OpenSanctions / Yente
candidates.preferred_use: improve alias/entity matching around official sanctions records while preserving the official source as the legal authority
candidates.must_not_do: Do not replace official UN, OFAC, UK or other issuing-authority records with an aggregator, and do not ingest datasets before commercial/license terms are cleared.
